key_insight: GANet reports 99.99% accuracy across 38 plant disease categories with only 0.001M parameters, targeting identification on low-power edge devices.
engineering_relevance: Its compact architecture could support local plant disease monitoring where computing power and connectivity are limited.
method: Group Attention block for feature processing.
Group-Wise Feature Fusion block for sparse, efficient computation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 99.99% accuracy on PlantVillage and inference rates of 5 FPS on Raspberry Pi 4b and 11 FPS on Jetson Nano.
watch_item: Performance under field conditions is not established by the abstract; validate robustness to lighting, backgrounds, and unseen disease presentations before deployment.
paper_title: GANet: A Lightweight Group Attention Network for Plant Disease Identification on Embedded Systems
